transcript: I've been keeping a little secret from you guys, which means by the time you're seeing this, I am probably on a plane to Canada because I am heading up to Gander for the weekend, which is the town where the events of the musical Come From Away take place. If you don't know come from away, it tells the true story of a town that took in a ton of stranded travellers during 9/11 when the US Airspace was closed. It is a small town of only a couple thousand people that basically doubled in size overnight. And the musical tells the story of the way this community came together for one another during this really dark and scary time in history. It is one of my all time favorite shows. There's actually a pro shot on Apple T V+ if you haven't seen it, highly recommend. But I've always been so struck by this story. And so now to get to go to the place where these events actually happened, I'll get to see the locations mentioned in the show, I'll get to meet some of the people that inspired the show. It is an absolute dream come true. And the cherry on top is that they're actually doing a production of Come From Away in Gander while I'm there. So I'm going to get to attend their opening night and see this story being told in the place where it actually happened. And that's gonna be So, so special. This is like a dream trip for me, something that I've wanted to do for so long, and so I'm so excited that the day is finally here and that I get to take you all with me. I'm going to be posting a ton of content from the trip over the next couple days, and if there's anything specific that you guys wanna see, let me know in the comments and I'll see what I can do.
classificationReason: Trip-planning vlog about visiting Gander, Newfoundland for a Come From Away-themed trip. Come From Away is not on the approved show list, and no listed production is discussed.
